column7: third #2700 site: core.UpdateSecretTemplate persisted through a bare Save, and SecretTemplate is HARD-deleted (no DeletedAt), so the 0-rows upsert fallback re-INSERTED a concurrently deleted template with its old id. Integrity only -- a template mints nothing by itself -- and the severity is low, stated as such rather than inflated. Fixed by UpdateSecretTemplateFields: a column-scoped UPDATE whose RowsAffected check IS the whole guarantee here, since there is no deleted_at to scope on. Red on real Postgres: the template row existed again after a delete that reported success
